name: Core Development Tools
description: Baseline tools (zsh, git, curl, jq, gpg, sudo) and devcontainer lifecycle runners. Works on any apt-based image.

idle_stop.description: Stop the container when VS Code has been disconnected for `idle_grace` seconds, so nothing runs unattended. Covers both window-close and CLI-launched (`devcontainer up`) containers, unlike devcontainer.json `shutdownAction`. Default off.

idle_grace.description: Grace period in seconds before idle-stop halts the container after VS Code disconnects. Only applies when `idle_stop` is enabled.

zsh_plugins.description: Space-separated oh-my-zsh plugins to enable in addition to the always-on `git`/`fzf` and any registered by other features (e.g. "z you-should-use"). Merged with the plugin registry at create time.
